title: acgs_validator_appointment/v1
description: EXTERNAL_VALIDATOR_ONBOARDING_V1: an evidence-backed appointment of a real human validator by a real external authority. Software never creates appointment facts — every field is transcribed from real appointment artifacts, and appointment_evidence digests bind the record to those artifacts' bytes. Registration into the validator registry is refused without a valid appointment.

validator_id.description: The registry validator id this appointment authorizes. A REGISTER event for any other id cannot claim this appointment (copied-identity defense).

subject_identity.description: The real person being appointed — transcribed from the artifact, never invented.

authorized_classes.description: The evidence classes the appointment actually grants. A REGISTER event may carry a subset, never a superset (scope-expansion defense).

appointment_authority.description: Who appointed this validator. MUST differ from subject_identity and validator_id — self-appointment is rejected structurally.

revocation_conditions.description: Under what conditions the appointment ends early, quoted from the artifact.

source_digest.description: sha256 of the real appointment artifact's bytes. Onboarding verifies each digest against a supplied document; a mismatch is forged evidence.

key_fingerprint.description: sha256 of the key material (HMAC: secret bytes; Ed25519: raw public key bytes).

public_key.description: Ed25519 only: raw public key, hex.

key_ownership_proof.description: Signature over canonical({appointment_binding, key_id}) with the bound key — proves the appointee controls the key (key-substitution defense).
